title: Structural Analysis Dashboard
summary: A React web app for beam deflection, SFD/BMD, torsion, stress analysis, section properties and a material library.
problem: Quick structural checks during design iteration usually meant switching to a spreadsheet or hand calculation, breaking flow.
solution: Built a dark, engineering-styled dashboard covering beam deflection, shear force and bending moment diagrams, torsion, stress analysis and cross-section properties, backed by a built-in material library — combining calculation rigor with fast, visual iteration.
